mods.name: Treasure Expansion
mods.description: Adds miscellaneous treasures to find, for better adventures.

releases.notes:
Changes:

* Updated for BTA 7.3_01
* There are now 3 new chest types that can exclusively be found in the 3 matching labyrinth types in BTA
* Undesired treasure items can now be crafted into treasure scrap (which can also rarely be found in labyrinths)
* Treasure scrap can be used to repair some items which previously took permanent damage

releases.notes:
## Changes:
* Piston Boots now give you the ability to step up full blocks
* Hellish quiver item (Major treasure), a quiver which shoots flaming arrows
* Flippers Item (Minor treasure), allow you to move faster in water
* Smoldering Tome and Hellish quiver are immune to fire as item entities
* Spider silk Item (Major Treasure) now provides a limited amount of climbing, and now spawns in labyrinths
* Strange Device renamed to Alien Gadget

mods.name: Treasure Expansion
mods.description: Adds miscellaneous treasures to find, for better adventures.

releases.notes:
Items:
-  NEW: Smoldering Tome
   - when in your inventory, protects you from all fire damage for ~9 seconds (doesn't break).
- NEW: Ball Of Spider Silk
    - Allows you to climb all blocks like ladders at 1.5 speed. Also greatly reduces the range spiders search to attack you.
    - Currently disabled, as I'm not sure if I like how it's balanced.
 - BUFFED: Silver Sword
    - Now it does diamond sword damage to monsters, but still has less durability (between iron and diamond tier) to make up for it's fire aspect 
    - does stone sword damage to non-monster enemies. 
 - BUFFED: Diving Helmet
    - there is no more penalty to digging underwater when wearing the diving helmet.
 Greatly Expanded Configuration Options:
 - You are now able to configure custom loot tables for treasure in labyrinths.
      - There is a loot table for major treasure per labyrinth type (desert, snow, and cobblestone), as well as one for minor treasure. 
      - You configure any item any item in here, including vanilla items or items from other mods, and an amount/random amount to spawn
 - You can disable minor treasure from ever spawning as well as the rarity of it appearing.
 - You can disable the random fruits from appearing in loot, if you prefer just apples.
 - You can configure the durability of every item with durability
